title: R1 dip/rip ensemble by futures group (rates, metals, energy, FX, ags), executable version, nested
rule: hourly roll-safe prices; per trade date the signal and fill use the close of the second-to-last hourly bar (one hour before the session end); range = hi/lo of closes up to then; indicators as R1 (RSI2 < 10, 5-day low, 3 down closes, IBS < 0.3; mirror for the short side: RSI2 > 90, 5-day high, 3 up closes, IBS > 0.7); size 0.10 / 60-day vol per root / n; held to the same snapshot next trade date; 2 x cost_frac per unit turnover
selection: best on 2010-06..2022-12 per group; enters only if > 0.3
judgement: book = Gen146 executable book (10 sleeves) + entrants, Sharpe-weighted on 2010-22; ONE evaluation 2023-26 vs 0.815
